mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months compresses the risk-free rate, reducing the discount rate applied to future equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.25 percentage points over 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate above 5.0% for two consecutive months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 45% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 5.0% for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in retail sales (RSAFS) and industrial production (INDPRO) indicates robust consumer demand and supply chain strength, which together signal expanding corporate profits and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint increase in RSAFS and INDPRO fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 55% of cases, or the correlation between the two series and SPX returns drops below 0.15 in a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% YoY), a rise in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) within the next month compresses equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 45% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 3.0% YoY and FEDFUNDS rises by at least 0.25 percentage points in the month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in retail sales (RSAFS) over the past 3 months indicates strong consumer demand, which supports corporate revenue growth and generates positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when RSAFS increases by at least 0.5% month-over-month for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 for two consecutive months signals a contraction in manufacturing output, which reduces corporate profits and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 45% of periods when INDPRO falls below 100 for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: In periods of low unemployment (UNRATE < 4.0%), a sharp increase in employment (PAYEMS) above 100,000 jobs in a month signals tight labor market conditions that may trigger inflationary pressures, leading to Fed tightening and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 45% of periods when UNRATE < 4.0% and PAYEMS increases by at least 100,000 jobs in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1900 thousand units for two consecutive months indicates a weakening real estate market, which reduces consumer wealth and spending, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 45% of periods when HOUST falls below 1900 for two consecutive months.
